title: Rephrase options
description: Returns three type-aware rephrasings of a tree node (questions stay questions, claims stay declarative, ideas stay tentative) as JSON.

variables.name: nodeType
variables.description: Node type; selects the tone rules.

variables.name: text
variables.description: Text to rephrase (sent JSON-encoded in the user message).

surfaces: POST /api/ai/rephrase (endpoint is live; no current client UI calls it since Rephrase left the My Vision Options menu)

usage.notes: symthink-io joins the system prompt into one paragraph; this template puts the type-specific rule on its own line. symthink-io fixes the limit at 280 characters (and truncates longer options); here it is the `maxChars` variable, defaulting to 280.
